mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_id, u.avatar_bg, f.accepted_at FROM friendships f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = CASE WHEN f.requester_id = #{userId} THEN f.addressee_id ELSE f.requester_id END WHERE f.status = 'accepted' AND (f.requester_id = #{userId} OR f.addressee_id = #{userId}) AND u.status = 'active' -- 탈퇴 계정이 남아 있어도 이름 빈 친구로 보이지 않게 ORDER BY f.accepted_at DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_id, u.avatar_bg, f.created_at FROM friendships f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.requester_id WHERE f.addressee_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_id, u.avatar_bg, f.created_at FROM friendships f JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.addressee_id WHERE f.requester_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
SELECT user_id, login_id, nickname, avatar_id, avatar_bg FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
SELECT requester_id, addressee_id, status FROM friendships WHERE (requester_id = #{a} AND addressee_id = #{b}) OR (requester_id = #{b} AND addressee_id = #{a}) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friendships (requester_id, addressee_id, status, created_at) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{addresseeId}, 'pending', now()) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friendships WHERE (requester_id = #{a} AND addressee_id = #{b}) OR (requester_id = #{b} AND addressee_id = #{a})
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_id, u.avatar_bg, f.status, CASE WHEN f.requester_id = #{meId} THEN 'outgoing' WHEN f.addressee_id = #{meId} THEN 'incoming' END AS direction FROM users u LEFT JOIN friendships f ON (f.requester_id = u.user_id AND f.addressee_id = #{meId}) OR (f.addressee_id = u.user_id AND f.requester_id = #{meId}) WHERE u.user_id <> #{meId} AND u.status = 'active' AND (lower(u.login_id) LIKE lower(#{q}) ESCAPE '\' OR u.nickname ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY u.nickname ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT p.personal_place_id, p.name, p.category, p.road_address, p.address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.kakao_place_id, p.memo, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.avatar_bg FROM personal_places p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.visibility IN ('friends', 'all') AND u.status = 'active' -- 탈퇴한 사람의 장소·메모는 조회되지 않게 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friendships WHERE addressee_id = #{userId} AND status = 'pending'
